alt: California Department of Social Services Public Records Act response correspondence for R013006-070526.
full_text: California Department of Social Services (CDSS) Reference No.: R013006-070526. Public Records Request received on July 05, 2026. Pursuant to the California Public Records Act and the Dymally-Alatorre Bilingual Services Act, Nicolas Hernandez requested digital copies of translated official fillable PDF forms EBT 2216, SOC 321, SOC 825, and PUB 13 into all 17 state threshold languages. CDSS produced a response confirming that several threshold translations are N/A (Not Available) for these life-safety IHSS forms, documenting systemic failure to comply with the Bilingual Services Act.
summary: Official Public Records Act correspondence from CDSS documenting systemic bilingual failures and unavailability of translated threshold life-safety IHSS forms.
